summary: pipavlo82 指出 EVM 上后量子签名讨论缺少可比较的基准：Falcon、ML-DSA 与 Dilithium 的 gas 对比常混用不同安全等级与验证面，提议统一分类与共享 XOF 测试向量。Vantana1995 提出 ERC-8129 不可转让代币，不再把灵魂绑定代币建在 ERC-721 之上。

items.title: Magicians：迈向 EVM 上可比较的后量子签名基准，验证面分类与共享 XOF 测试向量
items.note: （pipavlo82）05:40：比较“每次验签 gas”时常混用 128、192、256 位安全目标与不同验证面，需要统一口径。
items.title_en: Magicians: Toward Comparable PQ Signature Benchmarks on EVM, surface taxonomy plus a shared XOF and test vector suite
items.note_en: (pipavlo82), 05:40: comparisons of gas per verify often mix 128, 192 and 256 bit targets and different verification surfaces, so a common basis is needed.

keywords_en: Comparable post-quantum signature benchmarks on the EVM
a DApp network configuration ERC merged
summary_en: pipavlo82 said post-quantum signature work on the EVM lacks comparable benchmarks: gas comparisons of Falcon, ML-DSA and Dilithium often mix security levels and verification surfaces, so the post proposes a shared taxonomy and XOF test vector suite. Vantana1995 proposed ERC-8129, a non-transferable token that no longer builds soulbound tokens on ERC-721.
